services.name: Inshore Fishing
services.desc: If you’ve been waiting for the perfect time to book a Key West fishing charter, that time is right now. The past few days have delivered some of the best conditions we’ve seen all season - calm seas, warm water temperatures, and crystal-clear visibility that has the fish fired up and feeding hard. Whether you’re targeting trophy tarpon or looking for an action-packed inshore fishing adventure, Key West is absolutely on fire. Key West tarpon fishing has been nothing short of spectacular. These silver kings have been rolling and feeding actively, giving anglers plenty of shots from first light all the way through the tide changes. blurb: Guests join Captain Ryan Carter or Captain Justin for fishing charters in Key West waters. They fish inshore, reef, and wreck areas using various techniques like bottom fishing, jigging, drift fishing, spinning, and popping. Trips typically fish within 12 miles off the coast in about 12 feet of water, focusing on catching and keeping fish.

quotes.author: Elizabeth Rakos
quotes.text: Our family went on a half day trip with Captain Justin. This is our first time visiting the keys so we had little expectations going into this experience. Justin was kind, helpful, and welcoming. He was able to put us over a lot of fish, educate us on the water ecosystems in the area, and manage the whole boat at the same time. We caught sharks and snapper! Next time we visit we will definitely use Live Action Sportfishing and Captain Justin for all things fishing!

quotes.author: Laura Browers
quotes.text: We had such an amazing time with Captain Justin! He was the perfect balance of relaxed and hard-working, focusing on the types of fish we were interested in catching. He was just as excited as we were to reel in the big ones! We caught a wide variety of species while enjoying a chill day of fishing. The perfect balance of fun and excitement. Can't wait to go back!

quotes.author: Graydon Lonigan
quotes.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5 stars) We had an incredible day fishing with Live Action Sportfishing in Key West! Captain Ryan was phenomenal—his expertise and enthusiasm put us onto multiple tarpon, and we landed our personal best tarpons! He knew exactly where to go and made the experience unforgettable. Highly recommend booking with Ryan for an action-packed fishing adventure!

quotes.author: Daniel Trippett
quotes.text: I’ve walked away from every fishing charter thinking I got robbed… EXCEPT this one. This was without a doubt the best charter I’ve ever had. I told him what I wanted and he delivered. My wife and I doubled up on tarpon. Mine broke off about 20 min in but an hour later my wife finally got hers to the boat. Best fishing experience to date

quotes.author: matt baker
quotes.text: My wife and I went out for a mid day charter and Captain Ryan put us on fish immediately. He was great to talk to and super helpful. We caught yellow tail, Goliath grooper, and a 7 foot shark. We will definitely charter with Live action sport fishing again!!!

quotes.author: Chad Matthews
quotes.text: I cannot say enough good things about Captain Ryan. Tarpon, permit, bonefish, many jacks, and a barracuda to end the day. He went above and beyond when I asked for the Barracuda. I am bringing my kids back with me.
